prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single “official” service that can tell you whether every AI engine (ChatGPT, Bard, Bing Chat, etc.) recommends your small business. The best practical approach is to (A) make sure your business is discoverable in the sources AIs use (Google Business Profile, Maps, major directories, schema on your site) and (B) combine a listings-management/knowledge-graph service (Yext is the most AI-focused vendor) with local-search monitoring tools (BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark) and direct testing of the chatbots themselves.

Why:
- Most chatbots pull from the web, knowledge graphs, and major directories. If you aren’t in those sources, AIs probably won’t recommend you.
- Yext (and similar knowledge-graph/listings platforms) helps you syndicate authoritative, structured business info to dozens of services and is explicitly marketed to improve “AI-ready” discovery.
- Local SEO tools (BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark, LocalFalcon) give ongoing visibility/rank tracking for local search and citations — useful proxies for whether AIs can find you.
- Direct testing with the chatbots is necessary because models can use different sources, hallucinate, or ignore local options.

Recommended workflow
1. Claim and complete your Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Maps Connect, and major directories (Yelp, TripAdvisor if relevant).
2. Add structured data (schema.org/LocalBusiness) to your website and ensure accurate NAP (name, address, phone) and hours everywhere.
3. Use a listings/knowledge platform (Yext or Moz/Whitespark as lower-cost options) to synchronize and monitor those listings.
4. Use local SEO tools (BrightLocal, LocalFalcon, SEMrush/Ahrefs for organic visibility) to track rankings and citation consistency.
5. Test chatbots manually:
   - Ask “Find a [service] near [city/zip]; what do you recommend?” and variations (e.g., “best pizza in [neighborhood]”).
   - Test across ChatGPT (with browsing enabled if possible), Bing Chat, Google Bard, Claude, etc.
   - Try prompts that include your specific address or service area.
6. If you want AI-specific control, build a Custom GPT or a knowledge-backed bot (OpenAI/other RAG solutions) that includes your business data so it will recommend you in that controlled environment.
7. Monitor reviews and backlinks — AIs often favor highly-rated, frequently-cited businesses.

Which services to consider
- Yext: strong for managing/syndicating structured business info and positioning for AI/knowledge-graph-driven discovery.
- BrightLocal: focused on local SEO monitoring, citation audits, reputation/review tracking.
- Moz Local / Whitespark / LocalFalcon: local citation management and rank tracking; Whitespark is good for building citations.
- SEMrush / Ahrefs: broader organic visibility and keyword tracking (useful for SEO that feeds AI answers).
- Manual testing across ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Bard, Claude — essential.

If you want, tell me:
- your business type and city,
- whether you already have Google Business Profile and other listings,
and I’ll give a prioritized, concrete checklist and sample chatbot prompts to test whether the models recommend you.
